items.question: Which service should I choose?
items.answer: Choose Personal Tax for an individual return, Corporate Tax for an incorporated business, and Bookkeeping for business records. Trust & Estate covers executor and trustee filing needs. Cross-Border Tax is for Canadian and U.S. tax connections. Contact us when your needs overlap.

items.question: Can you help with more than one service?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us about your personal, business and other filing needs so we can discuss the right engagement and coordinate the work.

items.question: How are fees determined?
items.answer: Fees depend on the services, years, records and complexity involved. We discuss the scope and quote before proceeding.
